world.title: Trump, in CBS interview, says deportation policy was ‘too tough’
world.summary: In a CBS interview excerpt aired on November 8, 2026, U.S. President Donald Trump stated that his mass deportation policy for undocumented immigrants was "too tough." The comments reflect a reconsideration of his previous stance on immigration enforcement. The interview was part of the program "60 Minutes," where Trump discussed various aspects of his presidency and policies.

world.title: Meet Vedant Thakker, the 16-year-old California student who built a free wildfire warning checker showing four location categories and is teaching Fremont seniors how to use it after a nearby brush fi
world.summary: Vedant Thakker, a 16-year-old student from California, developed a free wildfire warning checker after experiencing a nearby brush fire. The tool categorizes locations into four risk levels. Thakker is also teaching seniors in Fremont how to use the checker, aiming to enhance community awareness and preparedness regarding wildfire risks in the area.

world.title: Democrats turn up heat on Hegseth, vow impeachment push after midterm victories
world.summary: US House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries has endorsed impeachment efforts against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, alleging abuse of power and manipulation of the war against Iran. Following recent midterm victories, Democrats are poised to leverage their congressional majority to pursue this initiative. The move reflects heightened tensions within the party regarding Hegseth's actions and their implications for national security.

business.title: Bank Holiday Today: Are Banks Open Or Closed On Monday, November 9? Check State-Wise Bank Holiday Status
business.summary: On Monday, November 9, banks in India will have varying hours. While some states will see branches closed due to Diwali and Laxmi Puja, others will operate as usual. Specifically, seven states and Union Territories will not have bank services available. Banks were closed on Sunday, November 8, for their regular weekly holiday.

business.title: Job scheme may see Rs 50,000-cr savings - Economy News
business.summary: The G RAM-G scheme, launched in July, replaces the MGNREGS rural job guarantee program to reduce leakages and enhance infrastructure development. This initiative is expected to save Rs 50,000 crore, allowing funds to cover additional fertilizer subsidies. The program emphasizes strategic funding and aims for a comprehensive reform of rural employment initiatives in India.

business.title: Dow futures gain 400 points amidst sharp swings in Nasdaq
business.summary: Dow futures rose by 400 points amid volatile trading conditions, while Nasdaq futures initially fell following Nvidia's announcement of an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a person suspected of being a Chinese spy. Concerns about Nvidia's influence on the AI market have intensified as Wall Street prepares for the upcoming trading week.

technology.title: Windows 11 Beta Moves to "26H2" Base; Microsoft Also Testing Simultaneous Face Recognition and PIN Entry
technology.summary: Microsoft updated the Windows 11 Insider Preview on November 6, transitioning the Beta Channel's standard release to "Windows 11 version 26H2." This update includes enhancements and new features, notably testing simultaneous face recognition and PIN entry for improved security. The changes aim to refine user experience and bolster system performance within the Insider Preview program.

technology.title: The iPhone Duo is a great foldable phone. The problem is what Apple charges for it
technology.summary: Apple's first foldable device, the iPhone Duo, features a comfortable user experience and high-quality construction. However, its starting price raises concerns about its value, making the device's compromises more noticeable. While the innovation may excite some users, the cost may deter others from considering it as a viable option in the foldable phone market.

technology.title: Motorola is quietly building apps and features that make Pixel and Samsung phones feel behind the times
technology.summary: Motorola is developing new apps and features for its Signature 27 smartphone, aiming to compete with Google Pixel and Samsung devices. The company focuses on enhancing user experience and functionality, potentially positioning its offerings as more advanced than those of its competitors. This shift in strategy may attract consumers who typically favor Pixel or Galaxy smartphones.

sports.title: ‘Worth half a goal’ - Fermin Lopez hails Lamine Yamal’s assist as Barcelona beat Atletico
sports.summary: Fermin Lopez praised Lamine Yamal's assist in Barcelona's victory over Atletico Madrid, highlighting its significance in securing the win. The two players collaborated effectively, with Lopez emphasizing the importance of Yamal's contribution to the team's success. Barcelona's performance showcased their tactical strengths, and the assist was a key moment in the match that led to the decisive goal.

sports.title: Mercedes' Toto Wolff already thinking about 2027 despite winning Constructors' Championship in Brazil
sports.summary: Mercedes Team Principal Toto Wolff is focused on the 2027 season, even after his team secured their ninth Constructors' Championship in Brazil. Following the race in Sao Paulo, where George Russell and Kimi Antonelli finished fourth and fifth, Wolff emphasized the importance of looking ahead to future challenges and opportunities for improvement within the team.

sports.title: 'Other countries don't allow it!' - Unai Emery hits out at Premier League officials after controversial Manchester United equaliser leaves Aston Villa furious
sports.summary: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery expressed frustration with Premier League refereeing after Manchester United's late equaliser by Patrick Dorgu resulted in a 4-4 draw. Emery criticized the officiating standards, highlighting that other countries do not permit similar decisions. His team had led 4-2 before conceding two late goals, leaving him visibly dejected on the touchline.

health.title: Emphasizing Preventive Healthcare and Technology Integration, ETHealthworld
health.summary: Union Minister Jitendra Singh emphasized the importance of preventive healthcare and technological integration in medicine at the 'Doc You Rock 2026' awards. He highlighted the need for a shift towards prevention and early diagnosis to address lifestyle-related diseases affecting the youth. Singh's remarks underscore the evolving landscape of healthcare delivery and the critical role of technology in improving outcomes.

health.title: Around 25% of teens had no physically activity in week in 2025: Study
health.summary: A global study revealed that approximately 25% of teenagers, equating to around 240 million, reported no physical activity in a week in 2025. This analysis highlights persistently low levels of adolescent physical activity over the past 15 years. The study also aims to reduce physical inactivity in adults and adolescents by 10% by 2025 and 15% by 2030.

health.title: Symptoms of New COVID-19 Strain PJ.2.1 May Be Similar to Cold or Flu
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that symptoms of the new COVID-19 strain PJ.2.1 may resemble those of a cold or flu. This similarity necessitates testing to confirm the diagnosis. The WHO emphasized the importance of distinguishing between COVID-19, influenza, and other respiratory illnesses to ensure appropriate treatment and public health measures are implemented effectively.

science.title: Stanford scientists have built a fingernail-sized chip that takes jumbled light from multiple sources and separates it into clean beams; the device could one day improve microscopes, telescopes and ca
science.summary: Stanford scientists have developed a fingernail-sized chip that can separate jumbled light from multiple sources into distinct beams. This innovative device has the potential to enhance the performance of microscopes, telescopes, and cameras. By improving light clarity and organization, the chip could significantly impact various fields that rely on precise light manipulation for imaging and analysis.

science.title: Ancient underwater canyons reveal clues to the world’s oldest animal life
science.summary: A study by Adelaide University geologists has found evidence that significant sea level changes carved large underwater canyons in South Australia's Flinders Ranges hundreds of millions of years ago. These geological formations contributed to conditions that preserved some of the earliest complex life on Earth, offering insights into the origins of ancient animal life and its development.

science.title: Nasa's Swift burns up, highlighting challenges of boosting satellites
science.summary: NASA's Swift observatory faced a failed rescue attempt, underscoring significant technical and fuel challenges in the satellite servicing industry. The mission involved a specialized spacecraft, LINK, aimed at extending Swift's operational life. This incident illustrates the complexities and obstacles that must be addressed as satellite servicing technologies continue to develop and evolve within the aerospace sector.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 9, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 9, 2026, Leos are advised to broaden their perspectives and consider all available options. The horoscope suggests that what you seek may already be close at hand. Emphasizing the importance of expanding one's vision, it encourages individuals to explore various possibilities and outcomes, highlighting that opportunities are abundant and not limited to what is immediately visible.

entertainment.title: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' box office collections day 4: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash's film approaches Rs 500 cr worldwide; crosses Rs 200 cr India net
entertainment.summary: Nitesh Tiwari's film 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' is performing well at the box office, with its worldwide gross approaching Rs 500 crore within four days of release. The mythological epic features actors Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. In India, the film has surpassed Rs 200 crore in net collections, indicating strong audience interest.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: November 9, 2026
entertainment.summary: Pisces individuals are encouraged to embrace transformation and recognize the peace that can accompany it. A new chapter in life is on the horizon, even if it hasn't fully manifested yet. This period of change may bring opportunities for growth and self-discovery. It is essential for Pisces to be open to the possibilities that lie ahead.
